content_type.description: How a deploy treats a file: raw writes its bytes as they are; template renders it with Go text/template and the agent's facts.
content_type.title: ContentType

group.description: Group that owns the file; left as written when empty

mode.description: Permissions in octal, such as 0644; when empty, a file keeps its mode and a new file gets 0644

object_name.description: The object of the object store, from osapi client file list

owner.description: User that owns the file; left as written when empty

path.description: Absolute path of the file on the host

vars.description: Variables of a template, as .Vars, each as key=value
